title: Verisk BINS
text:
Verisk
 BINS

In 
Touchstone
 11.0, we added validation
 rules for 
Verisk
 BINS ID location
 fields.

Select an exposure view, a contract in the contract list, the 
Contract
 Details
 pane, and then the locations.

| Field | Description | Validation rules | Default value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| VERISK BINS ID Unit | Verisk BINS ID for a
 unit | Characters 1-4 = "VRSK" Characters 5 and 6 = "US" Character 7 must be "U" Characters 8 and 14 are underscores (_). Characters 9-13 are "AANNN" Characters 15-23 are random alphanumeric values | n/a |
| VERISK BINS ID Building | Verisk BINS ID for a
 building | Characters 1-4 = "VRSK" Characters 5 and 6 = "US" Character 7 must be "B" Characters 8 and 14 are underscores (_). Characters 9-13 are "AANNN" Characters 15-23 are random alphanumeric values | n/a |
| VERISK BINS ID Site | Verisk BINS ID for a
 site | Characters 1-4 = "VRSK" Characters 5 and 6 = "US" Character 7 must be "S" Characters 8 and 14 are underscores (_). Characters 9-13 are "AANNN" Characters 15-23 are random alphanumeric values | n/a |
| VERISK BINS ID Campus | Verisk BINS ID for a
 campus | Characters 1-4 = "VRSK" Characters 5 and 6 = "US" Character 7 must be "C" Characters 8 and 14 are underscores (_). Characters 9-13 are "AANNN" Characters 15-23 are random alphanumeric values | n/a |
